name: land on prescribed evaluation times with exact rhs evaluation
definition: for each requested output time, clamp the final substep of an interval so the solver evaluates rhs exactly at that time rather than interpolating.
failure_mode: interpolating or skipping the landing step means no rhs call coincides with eval_t, failing the landing check

name: leave numpy importable system-wide
definition: ensure the numeric library is present and imported before the tests import it
failure_mode: a missing numpy raises at import

name: locate the source of a running process when its script is deleted from disk
definition: Identify the live python process behind the server and trace back to the deleted-but-open source via its held file descriptor.
failure_mode: Wrong process or failure to attach to the open deleted file.

name: make multiprocessing robust inside a container entry-point
definition: Guard worker spawning so importing/executing the module in a script doesn't recursively re-run the main body (e.g. under __main__ guard / picklable targets).
failure_mode: Un-guarded spawn re-executes the module/loop, causing hang or wrong results.
